_comment: Fixed-date opportunities. These are not scraped postings — they are dates that must not slip, and the daily digest counts down to them. Copy to data/deadlines.json and replace with your own. Leave verified=false on any date you have not confirmed at the source; the email marks those as needing a check.

items.title: Round 1 application deadline
items.note: Earliest of the programs on the list; everything else keys off this one.

items.title: Ask three referees
items.note: Eight weeks before the earliest deadline. Asking late is the usual way this slips.

items.title: Language test score expires
items.note: Retake needed if any target deadline falls after this.

items.title: Working holiday registration opens
items.note: Age-capped programme — confirm the exact opening date at the source.

items.title: Autumn public-sector intake closes
items.note: Annual cycle; date is from last year and must be re-checked.

items.title: Workshop decision notification
items.note: Result changes how the applications describe the paper.
